content.title: How to watch Lakers vs. Pistons: TV channel and streaming options for March 23
content.text: A pair of hot teams square off when the Los Angeles Lakers (46-25) visit the Detroit Pistons (51-19) on March 23, 2026. The Lakers will put their nine-game win streak on the line against the Pistons, who have won three straight.How to watch Los Angeles Lakers vs. Detroit Pistons Venue: Little Caesars Arena Time: 7 p.m. ET TV: FDSDET, SportsNet LA, WMYD Watching in person? Get tickets on StubHub.
